page.overview:
Who is Valdusian Tomer?

Valdusian Tomer was a good planeswalker.

During the Great Magus War on Antausia, Valdusian was an apprentice to Ignatius Firestorm. Together, they challenged the evil sorceress Dinitra La Croix for control of the Beldingard power pools, which they took easily.

After the war, Valdusian recorded histories of the realms of Antausia.
